messages.subject: Plot boxplot without outiler
parts:
Hi all

I just want to draw boxplot without showing outlier (showing box only)
with several datasets in one panel.

would yo advise me how to do it?

Followings are script I am working on

---------------------------------------------------------------
set1$set <- A
set2$set <- B

all <- rbind(set1,set2)
allm <- melt(all, id="set")

p <-ggplot(allm, aes(set, value))
p+geom_boxplot()+facet_grid(set ~ variable)
---------------------------------------------------------------

cheers,
